purpose: Gwanghwamun elite (haetaeHead) and weekly monsters, copied unchanged from art-library/game-ready/monster

assets.name: 해태 균열두
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE legless monster sprite PNG for Seoul Hero, cute but threatening SD survivor game. Reference images are the game's SD hero and existing monsters: match their crisp bold rounded near-black line art, simple clean cel-shaded two-tone color blocks, saturated clear colors and toy-like readability, not the hero's humanoid anatomy. The creature is an urban gate monster born in present-day Seoul; its everyday-city motif must be obvious at a glance. Composition: full isolated single creature centered, front three-quarter view from a little above, all parts fully visible, generous transparent margin, big readable eyes with an angry or sly expression, role readable at 40px. One coherent compact silhouette with few broad shapes. Every monster MUST have ZERO legs, ZERO feet, ZERO shoes, ZERO human walking joints, ZERO arms/hands; only the wings, fins, tails, ribbons or continuous body named in the subject are allowed. Not babyish: no smiley faces, no blush stickers, no pastel candy look, no round button eyes without brows. No painterly or semi-realistic rendering, no soft airbrush gradients, no heavy surface texture, no muted gold/navy ornament palette, no realistic horror/gore/fur, no photorealism, no flat vector/clip-art look, no ground shadow, no background, no glow haze beyond silhouette, no text, no frame, no extra monsters, no sprite sheet. Real transparent background.
Subject: A LARGE ELITE CRACKED HAETAE STATUE HEAD: only a floating Korean guardian haetae stone head, broad sculpted gray muzzle and stylized chunky curled stone mane, vivid purple fissure light contained in the mane cracks, huge glaring yellow eyes, short stone fangs, no neck torso or limbs, imposing weight with very few broad carved shapes.
Input images: image 1 hero style reference only; images 2-5 monster style references. Match their bold contour thickness and large expressive eyes. Canvas: approximately 1216 x 1293 portrait; centered creature spans about 88% width with ample empty margin above and below. Two-tone cel shade per material with small crisp highlights. Any luminous parts use solid crisp color shapes, never bloom or fuzzy glow.
